messages:
Lia (AE): Heads up — Acme sent back the SIG. They flagged a few must-have evidences and want everything by COB Fri. Can we confirm what we can hand over without legal review first? @Tom @Elena
Maria (SE): Which questions did they mark as blockers?
Lia (AE): Q12 (encryption at rest), Q27 (admin access logs), Q34 (network segmentation diagrams). Also asked about KMS rotation cadence.
Tom (InfoSec): We can provide KMS policy + rotation cadence doc. For admin logs we can give a redacted CloudTrail export. Need to scrub ARNs and user emails before sending.
Elena (Legal): Agree — redact PII and tenant identifiers. If they want raw logs we need an NDA addendum; otherwise an attestation + redacted exports is ok.
Paul (Acme): Quick note: we explicitly requested evidence showing rotation cadence and last rotation date. Attestation is fine but we prefer a sample log snippet.
Tom (InfoSec): Sample redacted event (will upload full redacted file):
```
{"eventTime":"2026-03-18T14:23:01Z","eventName":"kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion","userIdentity":{"type":"AssumedRole","arn":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-admin"},"requestParameters":{},"responseElements":null}
```
Lia (AE): Perfect. Maria — can you package network diagram and allowed port list? Acme expects VPC/subnet level detail.
Maria (SE): Yep. I have the VPC diagram in draw.io, will export PDF and redact internal hostnames. Any preferred format?
Elena (Legal): PDF + brief narrative describing segmentation (private mgmt plane vs app plane) works. No internal hostnames or IPs.
docu-bot: Uploaded files to s3://redwood-sig/ACME-2026-03-18/ (acme-sig-index.json, kms-rotation-policy.pdf, cloudtrail-redacted-0318.json, vpc-segmentation.pdf)
Maria (SE): Uploaded vpc-segmentation.pdf and a ports list to the S3 path. Linking here: https://s3.redwood.internal/redwood-sig/ACME-2026-03-18/vpc-segmentation.pdf
Tom (InfoSec): I uploaded the redacted CloudTrail export and a short readme describing redaction steps. README snippet: "We replaced account IDs and usernames with REDACTED_TOKEN to preserve audit shape while protecting PII."
Elena (Legal): I'll prepare a one-paragraph controls attestation that covers SOC2 controls for logging, KMS rotation policy, and access reviews. ETA Thu EOD.
Lia (AE): Thanks. Plan: Maria assembles answers into the SIG spreadsheet, Tom attaches the redacted logs as evidence links, Elena provides attestation. I'll send to Paul once Elena signs off.
Paul (Acme): Sounds good. Can we get a heads-up when the spreadsheet is ready? Friday COB is firm.
Maria (SE): Will ping here when the spreadsheet row for Q12/Q27/Q34 is filled.
Tom (InfoSec): Quick note — Q27 also asked about retention period. Our standard is 90 days for raw CloudTrail and 1 year for aggregated alerts. I'll include exact policy names.
Elena (Legal): Also confirm we won't include any customer data from the POC. If anything arises that looks like customer content, escalate to me.
Lia (AE): Noted. Anything else?
Paul (Acme): No, that's it — appreciate the fast turnaround :thumbsup:
Maria (SE): Spreadsheet row updated and links posted to S3.
Tom (InfoSec): Redacted export uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/redwood-sig/ACME-2026-03-18/cloudtrail-redacted-0318.json
Elena (Legal): Attestation posted to S3 and signed.
Lia (AE): Sending to Acme now. Will follow up if they request raw logs or further clarification.
Paul (Acme): Received — thanks everyone.
Maria (SE): ack
Tom (InfoSec): closing this thread after we get confirmation from them.
Lia (AE): closing — great teamwork :rocket:
